decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: Only tests of the existing Fetch contract are added. No exported API, compatibility policy, or external contract is created or changed.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Go test implementation benefits from ordinary formatting, errors-as-values assertions, local state, and visible goroutine ownership.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: The production dependency wiring and resource lifecycle remain unchanged. Tests use the existing http.Client/Transport boundary without a new production interface or seam.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: No package, responsibility, import ownership, or production package boundary changes.

decisions.name: go-test-isolation
decisions.reason: Tests introduce handwritten transport/body doubles, owned local HTTP servers, concurrent subtests, cancellation events, worker joins, and bounded teardown.
